researched_by: desk research from council's own published pages
policy_summary: Pilot scheme: three coastal car parks with numbered, bookable motorhome bays for self-contained vehicles, GBP12 per night, 6pm-8am, one night only, online booking only. Overnight sleeping is prohibited in every other council car park, enforced by PCN. A 'motor caravan protocol' was agreed with the AONB. Provision and prohibition published together on the same pages - the clearest published position of any authority researched so far.
notes: IMPORTANT: the restriction is on SLEEPING IN ANY TYPE OF VEHICLE, not on motorhomes specifically. That is the broadest definition encountered - it catches car campers too. The provision, by contrast, requires a self-contained motorhome.

sites.name: Amble Braid Car Park, Amble
sites.self_contained_definition: toilet, sink and waste storage facilities on board
sites.notes: On the River Coquet off the A1068 near Amble Marina and the Coquet Yacht Club. Bays 1-3 are the overnight ones, with 6 further bays for daytime parking. Restaurants and cafes within walking distance. Postcode conflict in sources: NE65 0GZ and NE65 0WU both appear - verify.
sites.price_note: GBP12 from 2022-2023 sources; a 2026 listing says GBP15. Verify.
sites.geocode_precision: car park centre - the Braid car park on the north bank of the Coquet by Amble Marina; two independent listings agree to within 10m

sites.notes: Off Links Road (B1340) on the southerly approach into Bamburgh, in direct view of Bamburgh Castle. Bays 1-5. CORRECTED from 6 - the council's own page says five.
sites.price_note: GBP12 from 2022-2023 sources; a 2026 listing says GBP15. Verify.
sites.geocode_precision: car park centre - the gravel car park on the west side of Links Road (B1340) directly opposite Bamburgh Castle; two independent listings agree to within 20m

sites.name: Beadnell Overflow Car Park, Beadnell
sites.self_contained_definition: toilet, sink and waste storage facilities on board
sites.notes: Off Harbour Road next to Beadnell Bay Beach. Also referred to as Benthall. Reported to have a toilet block at the end of the car park - verify.
sites.price_note: GBP12 from 2022-2023 sources; a 2026 listing says GBP15. Verify.
sites.geocode_precision: centre of the Beadnell Bay car park off Harbour Road, of which the overflow is part; the overflow bays themselves are the northern area, up to about 250m from this point

sites.name: All other Northumberland County Council car parks
sites.notes: Council wording: sleeping in ANY TYPE OF VEHICLE is not allowed elsewhere in the pilot car parks or in any other council car park. Cooking and camping likewise. Broadest definition found so far - catches car campers, not just motorhomes. Needs the full council car park list and geometry to be mappable.

price_warning: Sources conflict on price. GBP12 appears throughout 2022-2023 reporting and user reviews; a 2026 listing quotes GBP15 for the overnight permit. Check the council booking system before publishing either figure.
